text: Because the Barclays award falls away rather than converting, it does not create a fixed claim giving managers a stake in the firm's liquidation value, and therefore it does not lower agency cost.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Contingent Capital in Executive Compensation (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2097160
